data.key: Implement School Focus Power ~ Philosopher's Touch
data.name: Philosopher's Touch [Transmutation]
data.description: As a standard action, you can expend 1 point of mental focus and touch up to %1 weapon(s), causing them to gain the properties of a special material. You can cause the weapon to be treated as cold iron or silver for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction for %2 minutes.|1+OccultistLVL/4|OccultistLVL

raw_tokens.value: Implement School Focus Power ~ Philosopher's Touch

As a standard action, you can expend 1 point of mental focus and touch up to %1 weapon(s), causing them to gain the properties of a special material. You can cause the weapon to be treated as cold iron or silver for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction for %2 minutes.|1+OccultistLVL/4|OccultistLVL

You can cause any weapon affected by this ability to act as if it were adamantine instead (but only for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction, not for overcoming hardness).|PREVARGTEQ:OccultistLVL,11
